threads.body: The narrowed `gen_ai.client.operation.exception` event has no reference emitter, so the non-inference side of this split is not demonstrated as required by `.github/instructions/evaluate-reference.instructions.md:7-9`. The OpenAI embeddings error scenario already triggers a real SDK `BadRequestError` but records only the span and metrics. Emit the broad exception event in `run_embeddings_reference()`'s error handler while the span is active, then regenerate `data.json`.

replies.body: The broad event already had no reference emitter before this PR. This PR demonstrates inference; the stacked embeddings PR #659 demonstrates embeddings using its dedicated exception event. Keeping the remaining broad-event coverage gap outside this inference-only change.

threads.body: The new failure path records the span and exception log but omits both operation-token histograms, leaving this failed call out of their operation counts. `model/gen-ai/token-metrics.yaml:125-128` specifies recording failed inference operations with `0` when usage is unavailable. Record zero samples for both histograms with `error.type`, then regenerate `data.json`.

nit:

`Logger.emit` takes the exception object directly (opentelemetry-api 1.45.1), and the SDK fills `exception.type`/`message`/`stacktrace` from it. Would be nice to use it here (then `traceback` import can go too):

```suggestion
                exception=error,
```

threads.body: The new event is dropped by the reference-report pipeline. `reference/src/semconv_genai/semconv_model.py`'s `_EVENTS` excludes it, so `_normalize_attr_data()` discards the OpenAI entry, and `data_files.py`'s `EVENT_TYPE_ORDER` also omits it. Consequently, `update-reports` produces neither a coverage row nor a detail page for this convention despite the captured SDK exception. Add the event to both mappings and the documentation-link map, then regenerate the reports.
